title.english: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring
title.native: 春夏秋冬代行者 春の舞

synonyms: Utusan Empat Musim: Tarian Musim Semi
Gli Agenti delle Quattro Stagioni: La Danza della Primavera
ลำนำรักผู้พิทักษ์ฤดูกาล ภาควสันตลีลา
Sứ giả bốn mùa: Vũ Điệu Mùa Xuân
description:
When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
__Occupation:__ Agent of Spring
__Power:__ Life Stimulation

Hinagiku went missing for around ten years, taking the season of spring with her.

~!She's been in love with [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki) since childhood.!~

~!She later reunites with Rosei and enters a relationship with him. Because she sees herself as a different person from before her kidnapping, Rosei begins calling her 'Hina'—a nickname only he is allowed to use.!~

__Occupation:__ Guard of Spring

A young woman who cherishes [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) greatly as her best friend and retainer. She falls into despair after Hinagiku's kidnapping and cuts ties with the Agent of Winter, [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki), and his Guard, [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), soon afterwards, despite her lingering feelings for Itecho.

~!After Hinagiku's return, Sakura gradually lets the Winter duo back into her and Hinagiku's lives once the four reunite, internally accepting her feelings for Itecho and becoming closer to him in the process.!~

__Occupation:__ Agent of Winter
__Power:__ Life Coagulation

A young man who's heart was hardened after [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping. His Guard is [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu), a trusted older brother figure of his since childhood. He is known to be rash with his powers, using them to protect others rather than to solely bring Winter.

~!Rosei begins a relationship with Hinagiku after reuniting with her. Out of consideration for Hinagiku's assertion that she is different from her old self, he begins to call her 'Hina', a nickname she only allows Rosei to use.!~

__Occupation:__ Guard of Winter

A calm and gentle young man who been at [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki)'s side since he was a teenager. He treats Rosei like his own younger brother and cares deeply for [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka), a girl he once tutored in the duties of a Guard before [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo)'s kidnapping.

~!Itecho later realizes his feelings for Sakura after mistakenly believing that she intended to marry a Spring Administration Official.!~

__Occupation:__  Agent of Summer
__Power:__ Life Operation

She is cheery and sweet but always argues with her elder twin sister, Ayame.

__Occupation:__ Guard of Summer

Ruri's elder sister and retainer. She plans on quitting as a Guard once she marries. Ruri has pushed her around since they were kids, but she wishes her only the best.

__Occupation:__ Guard of Autumn

He thinks he sees his Guard role as only a job, but it doesn't look so from the outside. Obliviously overprotective of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/320099/Iwaizuki-Nadeshiko).

__Occupation:__ Agent of Autumn
__Power:__ Life Putrefaction

The newest and youngest of the Agents. She is greatly fond and trusting of [Rindo](https://anilist.co/character/320098/Azami-Rindo).

__Occupation:__ Insurgent

Leader of the "Kasai" reformist group.

~!She's the woman who organized the Town of Winter incident where [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayou) was kidnapped!~

She's a little girl who [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka) met while heading to Mount Ryugu. She's the first person to witness the return of Spring.

__Occupation:__ Member of the Four Seasons Agency Autumn Division's Security Department.

She is responsible for the Town of Autumn's security system. She is an intelligent woman with a career that allows her to operate flexibly. She considers Rindo a little brother.

__Occupation:__ Member of the Town of Winter's elite security

Along with Todo, he guards [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayo) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka) on [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki) and [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu)'s will. He holds [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu) in high regard.

__Occupation:__ Insurgent

[Misuzu](https://anilist.co/character/397666/Misuzu-Henderson)'s right-hand man. He wants to leave the group and start a new life, but he's in love with her.

__Occupation:__ Member of the Town of Winter's elite security

He's a kind and caring agent who guards [Hinagiku](https://anilist.co/character/319954/Hinagiku-Kayou) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/319956/Sakura-Himedaka) on [Rosei](https://anilist.co/character/319955/Rosei-Kantsubaki) and [Itecho](https://anilist.co/character/319957/Itechou-Kangetsu)'s orders.

~!He monitored Rosei and Hinagiku's relationship 10 years earlier and was involved in the Town of Winter incident.!~
